title: The CISO’s evolving role: Protecting and defending in the agentic era
description: This analysis discusses the evolving role of Chief Information Security Officers (CISOs) in managing security risks introduced by the rapid adoption of AI agents within enterprises. The proliferation of AI agents that access company data and perform actions on behalf of employees introduces new security challenges, especially as many builders of these agents may lack traditional security expertise. CISOs must implement strong governance around agent identities and data access, maintain deep observability of agent behavior, and adapt defense strategies to counter faster, AI-enabled attacks. The focus is on enabling innovation while managing risk through identity governance, data protection, and integrated security operations.
